objective: Computation: exact full tables of every census stage up to the bound, canonical forms, table isomorphisms between non-isomorphic arrangements, and their growth.
status: Supported 2026-11-19 (referee pending): among 52,163 census stages of at most 14 junctions (complete rounds, cheapest counts), 9,498 groups of non-isomorphic arrangements share an exact table up to renaming; 4,626 have two or more grown members; 152 of those have other allowed states (none same-lineage, all from starts whose knots share two distinctions), and they persist (85 of 88 one table again next round, 54 of 54 two rounds on); where junctions meet once, the 80 grown groups all keep the states. G, P1, P2, P5 held; P3, P4 failed.
title: Census stages with one table
